from pathlib import Path
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from datetime import datetime,timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re,pandas as pd
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name,obj):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
freeze=json.loads((out/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
calendar=json.loads((out/'source_calendar_freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
receipts=json.loads((out/'release_download_receipts.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['receipts']
assert (out/'source_gate.json').exists() and not (out/'model_registration.json').exists()
first_gate=json.loads((out/'source_gate.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert first_gate['release_count']==183 and len(first_gate['failures'])==25
assert not (out/'第一次解析_source_gate.json').exists()
for name in ['source_gate.json','208次实际周公布准备金构成.parquet','全部原表五字段.csv']:
    (out/('第一次解析_'+name)).write_bytes((out/name).read_bytes())
failed_dates={x['event_id'] for x in first_gate['failures']}
assert sha(out/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
assert len(receipts)==len(calendar['dates'])==208
assert [r['date'] for r in receipts]==calendar['dates']
def dateparse(s):
    for fmt in ['%b %d, %Y','%B %d, %Y']:
        try:return datetime.strptime(s,fmt).date()
        except ValueError:continue
    raise ValueError(s)
def number(s):return int(re.sub(r'[\s,]','',s).replace('\u2212','-'))
keys=dict(zip(protocol['source_fields'],['supply','absorption','reserve','rrp','tga']))
records=pd.read_parquet(out/'208次实际周公布准备金构成.parquet').to_dict('records')
rawrows=pd.read_csv(out/'全部原表五字段.csv',dtype={'event_id':str}).to_dict('records')
failures=[]
for rec in receipts:
    if rec['date'] not in failed_dates:continue
    try:
        assert rec['status'] in ['SAVED_ORIGINAL','REUSED_FROZEN_E8_ORIGINAL']
        p=root/rec['path'];assert sha(p)==rec['sha256']
        soup=BeautifulSoup(p.read_bytes(),'html.parser');text=' '.join(soup.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
        m=re.search(r'Release\s+Date:\s*(?:[A-Za-z]+,\s*)?([A-Za-z]+\s+\d{1,2},\s*\d{4})',text)
        assert m,'未定位实际公布正文日期'
        released=dateparse(m.group(1));assert released.strftime('%Y%m%d')==rec['date']
        tables=soup.find_all('table');values={};dates_by_table=[]
        weekly_tables=[i for i,t in enumerate(tables) if 'Averages of daily figures' in ' '.join(t.get_text(' ',strip=True).split()) and 'Reserve Bank credit, related items, and reserve balances' in ' '.join(t.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())]
        assert len(weekly_tables)==2,'同频准备金表数量不为2'
        for ti in weekly_tables:
            t=tables[ti];header=' '.join(t.get_text(' ',strip=True).split())
            assert 'Averages of daily figures' in header
            ds=[dateparse(x) for x in re.findall(r'[A-Z][a-z]+\s+\d{1,2},\s*\d{4}',header[:350])]
            assert len(ds)>=4 and ds[0]==ds[1]
            current,prior=ds[1:3];assert current-prior==timedelta(days=7) and current<=released
            dates_by_table.append((current,prior))
            for tr in t.find_all('tr'):
                cells=[x.get_text(' ',strip=True) for x in tr.find_all(['th','td'],recursive=False)]
                if len(cells)!=5:continue
                label=re.sub(r'\s+\d+$','',' '.join(cells[0].split()))
                if label not in keys:continue
                assert label not in values
                value={'level':number(cells[1]),'change':number(cells[2])};values[label]=value
                rawrows.append({'event_id':rec['date'],'source_field':label,'week_ended':str(current),'previous_week_ended':str(prior),
                    'weekly_average_level_million_usd':value['level'],'weekly_average_change_million_usd':value['change'],'table_index':ti,
                    'source_url':rec['url'],'source_sha256':rec['sha256']})
        assert len(set(dates_by_table))==1 and set(values)==set(keys)
        item={'event_id':rec['date'],'release_date':pd.Timestamp(released),'week_ended':str(current),'previous_week_ended':str(prior),
            'source_url':rec['url'],'source_path':rec['path'],'source_sha256':rec['sha256'],
            'available_at':pd.Timestamp(datetime.combine(released,datetime.min.time()).replace(hour=23,minute=59,second=59,tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York'))).tz_convert('Asia/Shanghai')}
        for label,key in keys.items():
            item[key+'_level']=values[label]['level'];item[key+'_delta']=values[label]['change']
        item['previous_reserve']=item['reserve_level']-item['reserve_delta'];assert item['previous_reserve']>0
        item['change_identity_error_million_usd']=item['supply_delta']-item['absorption_delta']-item['reserve_delta']
        item['level_identity_error_million_usd']=item['supply_level']-item['absorption_level']-item['reserve_level']
        assert abs(item['change_identity_error_million_usd'])<=3 and abs(item['level_identity_error_million_usd'])<=3
        for field,value in zip(protocol['cause_definitions'],[item['supply_delta'],-item['rrp_delta'],item['tga_delta']]):
            item[field]=100*value/item['previous_reserve']
        item['other_absorption_delta']=item['absorption_delta']-item['rrp_delta']-item['tga_delta']
        item['source_first_vintage_verified']=False
        records.append(item)
    except Exception as e:
        failures.append({'event_id':rec['date'],'error_type':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e)})
df=pd.DataFrame(records).sort_values('event_id').reset_index(drop=True)
df.to_parquet(out/'208次实际周公布准备金构成.parquet',index=False)
df.to_csv(out/'208次实际周公布准备金构成.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
pd.DataFrame(rawrows).to_csv(out/'全部原表五字段.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
gate={'completed_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
 'status':'PASSED_ORIGINAL_RELEASE_DATE_WEEKLY_AVERAGE_PROXY' if len(records)==208 and not failures else 'SOURCE_GATE_NOT_PASSED',
 'all_actual_calendar_dates_present':len(records)==208 and not failures,'calendar_count':208,'release_count':len(records),'raw_field_count':len(rawrows),
 'calendar_year_counts':{str(y):int(df.release_date.dt.year.eq(y).sum()) for y in (2022,2023,2024,2025)},
 'non_thursday_publications':df.loc[df.release_date.dt.dayofweek.ne(3),'event_id'].tolist(),
 'max_abs_change_identity_error_million_usd':int(df.change_identity_error_million_usd.abs().max()) if len(df) else None,
 'max_abs_level_identity_error_million_usd':int(df.level_identity_error_million_usd.abs().max()) if len(df) else None,
 'series_path':str((out/'208次实际周公布准备金构成.parquet').relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'),
 'series_sha256':sha(out/'208次实际周公布准备金构成.parquet'),'source_hashes':{r['path']:r['sha256'] for r in receipts if 'sha256' in r},
 'failures':failures,'source_first_vintage_verified':False,'actual_historical_receipt_verified':False,
 'availability':'实际正文日纽约23:59:59转上海的保守公开日代理；并非历史当年收件或首版认证',
 'equity_labels_loaded':False,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_code_edits':0}
save('source_gate.json',gate)
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in gate.items() if k!='source_hashes'},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))

save('解析修正回执.json',{'recorded_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
 'first_source_gate_sha256':sha(out/'第一次解析_source_gate.json'),'first_passed':183,'layout_shift_dates':sorted(failed_dates),
 'implementation_cause':'25份HTML含额外公告表，准备金表DOM序号移位；改按周均及准备金表头定位',
 'fixed_fields_changed':False,'economic_definition_changed':False,'calendar_or_samples_changed':False,
 'model_parameters_changed':False,'equity_labels_loaded_before_repair':False,
 'reparsed_original_objects':25,'additional_downloads':0,'final_passed':len(records),'final_source_gate_sha256':sha(out/'source_gate.json')})
